kevin: Noticed a weird perf cliff on AMD GPUs when sequence tail increases. Our route selector picks rocm_v2_fast for short seqs but when the traffic has a 100-140 tail p95 jumps.

sophia: saw it in yesterday's perf job. kernel_indexer is returning misses for a subset of op signatures -> falling back to generic_gemm_rocm which is ~2-3x slower. KV cache hits also drop during the window.

kevin: staging numbers:
```
model: gpt-medium-16b
seq=64 p95: 46ms
seq=128 p95: 118ms  <-- cliff
batch=4 p99: 340ms
rocm_v2_fast hitrate: 70% -> 33% when tail present
fallback: generic_gemm_rocm (~+2.5x)
```

alex: is this related to the indexer pruning change? we pruned sparse signatures to shrink table.

sophia: yes, indexer prune removed entries that matched SM75/SM80 kernel variants. Only pure ROCm routes impacted; cpu/hybrid still hit optimized kernels.

maria: temporary mitigation idea: sequence-bucket routing. short (<96) -> rocm_v2_fast, mid (96-192) -> rocm_v2_mid, long -> fallback. Avoids per-op signature lookup for mid range.

ryan: extra problem: KV cache keys include kernel-id. When we switch kernels, KV misses spike and we re-upload KV shards, adding ~15-25ms churn per request.

kevin: short-term plan:
- add seq-aware conditional routing for 96-192 to prefer rocm_v2_mid
- revert indexer pruning for AMD until we stabilize
- introduce kernel aliasing so KV keys remain stable across id churn

alex: long-term: autotuner should see seq distribution and pick kernels accordingly. Need metrics: per-kernel hitrate hist and latency contours by seq.

sophia: ddtrace snippet I grabbed:
```
TRACE: route_select -> kernel_lookup (10ms)
kernel_lookup -> compile_check (5ms)
fallback exec generic_gemm_rocm (30ms)
KV hitrate 0.88 -> 0.55 during switch
```

maria: kicked a canary that pins mid kernels for 24h. infra-bot will post charts to #eng-releases. @kevin watch p95/p99.

infra-bot: deploy canary rocm-seq-pin-2026-03-15 to pool amd-staging-3 by maria. Canary ID 8632. Metrics: https://internal-metrics/reports/8632

kevin: first 45m look good. seq=128 p95 improved from 118ms -> 60ms after pin. Need to validate seq64 unaffected.

ryan: quick patch to reduce KV churn: include stable kernel_alias in KV key: `kv_key = model|prefix|kernel_alias_v1`. Prevents reuploads while aliasing in flight.

sophia: pre-roll checklist:
- A/B p95/p99 per seq bucket
- KV hit/miss deltas
- logits sanity check between aliased kernels
- memory footprint on ROCm nodes

alex: canary stays 24-48h. If stable we'll ship seq-aware routing + alias patch then re-enable indexer prune with reduced TTL.

maria: added card on runtime board: /boards/runtime/rocm-seq-routing. CC infra + ml-opt.

kevin: thanks. I'll follow up with a short incident note if we see more flakiness. :thumbsup:
